{{Top}}
'''Greth Lan-Dwu Corporation''' was an energy company of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that owned a number of power-generating facilities across the entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] chased the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] through one such facility after Wesell made an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] life.
